# xAgent

> xAgent is a task-first, self-hosted multi-user AI agent platform. It organizes Agents, Skills, Tools, MCP, Connectors, isolated workspaces, long-running tasks, approvals, and operational governance in one server-side work portal.

xAgent documentation is maintained as paired Chinese and English pages. Use the page matching the requested language. Product behavior and release details can change during beta, so prefer the linked documentation and changelog over third-party summaries.

## Start Here

- [What is xAgent? (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/getting-started/what-is-xagent/): Product positioning, deployment model, capabilities, safety boundaries, and release positioning.
- [什么是 xAgent？（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-xagent/): 产品定位、部署方式、核心能力、安全边界与发布定位。
- [Install xAgent (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/getting-started/install/): Server installation, system setup, verification, and upgrade workflow.
- [安装 xAgent（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/getting-started/install/): 服务端安装、系统初始化、验证与升级流程。
- [User Manual (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/manual/overview/): Page-by-page guide to the current xAgent console.
- [xAgent 使用手册（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/manual/overview/): 当前 xAgent 控制台的逐页使用说明。

## Core Capabilities

- [Agent Sessions](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/agent-session/): Submit goals and files, follow execution, handle approvals, and refine results.
- [Long-running Tasks](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/long-task/): Continuous server-side execution and staged delivery.
- [Long-Term Memory](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/memory/): Explicitly retain durable preferences, decisions, and boundaries across sessions, then recall them with source and freshness checks.
- [Skills](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/skill/): Create, test, publish, and update reusable task methods.
- [Tools](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/tool/): Personal and public Tools, MCP, Connector tools, discovery, and execution.
- [Connectors](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/connector/): WeChat, Telegram, Feishu, browser connections, messages, files, and health state.
- [Approval Policies](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/approval-policy/): Control sensitive Tool actions with user and administrator rules.
- [Workspace Files](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/user-guide/workspace/): Isolated task materials, generated files, intermediate results, and downloads.
- [Supported Agent Capabilities](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/manual/capabilities/): Built-in Skills and current file-processing boundaries.

## Architecture Guides

- [Self-host an AI Agent](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/guides/self-hosted-ai-agent/): Server preparation, model access, HTTPS, isolation, connectors, backups, and continuous execution.
- [Dynamic Capability Discovery](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/guides/ai-agent-dynamic-tool-discovery/): Discover and load Skills and Tools on demand instead of loading everything into context.
- [Approval and Safety Controls](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/guides/agent-approval-security/): Reduce Tool calls to governed actions, pause risky operations, approve, and resume.
- [Workspace and Process Isolation](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/guides/multi-user-workspace-isolation/): Virtual workspaces, Execution Leases, ProcessSandbox, and Runtime Assets.
- [Runtime and ProcessSandbox](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/architecture/runtime/): Runtime ownership, sandbox file views, resource limits, platform backends, and Runtime Assets.
- [Multi-Agent Session Events](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/guides/multi-agent-session-event-collaboration/): Exchange status, tasks, and file references without crossing user boundaries.
- [Runtime Model and Skill Switching](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/guides/ai-agent-runtime-hot-switching/): Change later model calls, Skills, Tools, and prompts while preserving task state.
- [Glossary](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/reference/glossary/): Standard meanings for Agent, Task, Skill, Tool, Connector, Memory, Session, Workspace, and Runtime terminology.

## Insights

- [DeepSeek Harness vs. xAgent (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/insights/deepseek-harness-vs-xagent/): An architecture decision guide comparing plugin composition, Session facts, task semantics, Tool governance, recovery, Subagents, and sandboxes.
- [DeepSeek Harness 与 xAgent（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/insights/deepseek-harness-vs-xagent/): 对比插件组合、会话事实、任务语义、Tool 治理、恢复、Subagent 与 Sandbox，说明两种 Agent Harness 路线分别适合什么场景。
- [How xAgent Sessions Understand Task Changes (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/insights/xagent-agent-harness-task-alignment/): A DeepSeek Harness task orchestration comparison that explains xAgent's outer loop for original input, task phases, Session-wide goals, Skills, and Tools.
- [xAgent 会话如何理解任务变化（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/insights/xagent-agent-harness-task-alignment/): 从 DeepSeek Harness 任务编排出发，对照 xAgent 如何保存原始输入、区分任务阶段，并按需调整 Skill 和 Tool。
- [How xAgent Tasks Run, Pause, and Resume (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/insights/xagent-agent-harness-execution-loop/): A DeepSeek Harness Agent Loop and tool loop comparison covering xAgent's Session runner, context assembly, Tool Calls, approvals, compression, and recovery.
- [xAgent 任务如何持续执行、暂停与恢复（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/insights/xagent-agent-harness-execution-loop/): 对照 DeepSeek Harness Agent Loop 与 Tool Loop，解释 xAgent 的 Session runner、上下文、Tool Call、审批、压缩和恢复。
- [AI Agents vs. AI Automation (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/insights/ai-agents-vs-ai-automation/): A decision guide with a controlled xAgent workflow, approval boundary, artifact failure, repair plan, and independent verification.
- [AI Agent 与 AI 自动化（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/insights/ai-agents-vs-ai-automation/): 基于一次受控 xAgent 任务，对比执行路径、适用场景、审批边界与产物复验。
- [AI Agent Skills vs. Tools vs. MCP (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/insights/ai-agent-tools-vs-skills/): Compare responsibilities, loading behavior, permissions, and selection criteria, then see how Skills, Tools, and MCP work together in one task.
- [AI Agent Skill、Tool 与 MCP（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/insights/ai-agent-tools-vs-skills/): 对比三者的职责、加载方式、权限与选型标准，并说明它们如何在一个任务中组合。

## Connector Specifications

- [Connector Architecture (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/attachments/xagent_connection_architecture/): Ownership, lifecycle, connection, event, and Tool projection boundaries.
- [Connector 架构（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/attachments/xagent_connection_architecture/): Connector 所有权、生命周期、连接、事件与 Tool 投影边界。
- [Connector Common Protocol 3.0 (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/attachments/xagent_connector_protocol/): HTTP endpoints, WebSocket packets, authentication, channels, transfers, errors, and third-party implementation requirements.
- [Connector 公共协议 3.0（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/attachments/xagent_connector_protocol/): HTTP 端点、WebSocket 数据包、认证、通道、文件传输、错误与第三方实现要求。
- [Connector Card JSON Schema (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/attachments/schemas/xagent.connector.v1.schema/): Machine-readable Connector capability declaration.
- [Connector Card JSON Schema（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/attachments/schemas/xagent.connector.v1.schema/): 机器可读的 Connector 能力声明。
- [Connection Descriptor JSON Schema (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/attachments/schemas/xagent.connection.v2.schema/): Machine-readable connection and target descriptor.
- [Connection Descriptor JSON Schema（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/attachments/schemas/xagent.connection.v2.schema/): 机器可读的连接与目标描述。
- [Connector Packet JSON Schema (English)](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/en/docs/attachments/schemas/xagent.connector.packet.v1.schema/): Machine-readable data-plane packet envelope.
- [Connector Packet JSON Schema（中文）](https://xagent.xiagaogao.com/docs/attachments/schemas/xagent.connector.packet.v1.schema/): 机器可读的数据面数据包封装。
